assumption: Most likely intended recent forced blow-up result; exact user conversation not located among available recent threads, clarification requested.

paper_statements.fact: Constructs a smooth force compactly supported in spacetime, zero initial velocity, finite kinetic energy and unbounded velocity as t approaches1.
Radial and axial core scales are tau^(1/2), tau^(1/2-h), speed tau^(-1/2-h), energy tau^(1/2-3h), 0<h<1/100.
Oscillatory pulses cancel annular residual stress; core alone is not the full solution.
Parameter magnitudes are chosen by sufficiently-small hierarchy, not fixed numerical constants.
Localize corrected vector potential/velocity/pressure, then define force as their full momentum residual.

implementation_status: Full corrected numerical profile/forcing evaluator not implemented. No claim of direct simulation of the published blow-up forcing.
representation_probe: moonshot_geometry.py tests a distinct divergence-free Gaussian swirl with prescribed concentrating scales. It is not a PDE solve and lacks paper corrections.
galerkin_bound: For exact fixed finite Fourier-Galerkin and integrable-in-time L2 forcing, energy cancellation bounds velocity L2; finite-dimensional norm equivalence bounds Linfinity. Fixed truncation cannot literally blow up with smooth bounded forcing. Native approximation must additionally control energy/divergence errors.
